scope: Static original-client evidence for BuildingFoundation significance registration and a distance-change handler; no runtime behavior ported.
identity: The FortSignificanceManager registration at 0x142ad8740 names FortSignificanceManager and references wrapper 0x142ad8b10, which jumps to constructor 0x141d2c800. The constructor stores vtable 0x145f987a8; its slot 0x268 contains 0x141d59d90.
registration: OnRep_ServerStreamedInLevel dynamic path calls 0x141d59c70(manager lookup value or null, foundation, 3). This helper indexes descriptor array at 0x1478c37a0 with stride 0x140, so index 3 uses 0x1478c3b60. At 0x141d59cd9-0x141d59d46 it copies callable objects at descriptor +0xd0 and +0x90, then at 0x141d59d48-0x141d59d6b calls manager virtual slot 0x268 with object, tag, those callables and descriptor byte. Constructor 0x141d2cc82-0x141d2ccd1 places target 0x141d398d0 in the +0x90 callable, and 0x141d2c800 also places 0x141d39420 in the +0xd0 callable. Separately, 0x141d2cc05-0x141d2cc43 places 0x141d394f0 in a descriptor +0x10 callable, which this registration helper does not copy. The target for the authenticated manager, 0x141d59d90, recognizes the BuildingFoundation tag, allocates a 0xe0-byte specialized record, initializes it, and adds it via 0x1409f1030. The null manager case would reach a virtual dereference; do not invent a null-safe registration contract.
distance_change_handler: Constructor 0x141d2c800 binds 0x141d427d0 to a delegate and reads AthenaBuildingFoundationStreamInDistance and AthenaBuildingFoundationStreamOutDistance into globals 0x1478c36cc and 0x1478c36d0. Handler 0x141d427d0 compares those globals to manager fields 0x150 and 0x154; under its observed object-flag and unchanged-value branches it simply updates the cached fields. Otherwise it invokes slot 0x260, looks up records by BuildingFoundation tag via 0x1409f0300, and for each record reads object +0x10 and float +0x20. With the streaming switch disabled or finite float >= 2.0 it calls 0x141bed450(object, false); with switch enabled and finite float <= 0.0 it calls 0x141bedfa0(object); values strictly between 0 and 2 leave the object alone. It then saves the current distances. 2.0 is verified at 0x1459ffea0. 0x1409f0300 returns a tag-associated array or a static empty array.
blockers: Specialized record construction and callbacks, registration lifecycle, delegate trigger, manager lookup null assumptions, and full stream-in/unload effects are not fully reconstructed. The exact significance semantics and full distance-change call context are not yet established. Therefore no callable partial implementation is proposed.
